plan: [This is a second-price sealed-bid auction with three bidders. Truthful bidding (bid = my private value) is a weakly dominant strategy: my payoff if I win equals my value minus the second-highest bid, so reporting my true value maximizes expected profit regardless of others. Values are independent each round and there's only one round, so bid my value $24 (allowed in $0.1 increments).]
